heading: Cancellation Policy
intro: This Cancellation Policy governs the cancellation of customer-specific procurement and order-fulfillment orders placed with Arseen Enterprises LLC. Because many Arseen Enterprises LLC orders involve customer-specific procurement and fulfillment, cancellation eligibility depends on the stage of the order and the costs already incurred. By engaging our services, you agree to the terms outlined below.

sections.title: Cancellation Before Procurement Begins — Full Refund Eligible
sections.body: If you request cancellation before Arseen Enterprises LLC has begun procurement, supplier payment, or any fulfillment activity on your order, you are entitled to a full refund of any amounts paid, less any non-recoverable payment-processing fees charged by the payment provider. Cancellation requests must be submitted in writing to support@arseenenterprises.com as soon as possible, with your order or invoice number and reason for cancellation. We will acknowledge your request within 1–2 business days and confirm your refund eligibility.

sections.title: Cancellation After Procurement or Fulfillment Has Begun
sections.body: Once supplier payment, procurement, order preparation, packaging, carrier booking, or shipment has begun, cancellation or refund eligibility may be limited based on actual costs already incurred and applicable law. Arseen Enterprises LLC will provide a written statement of costs already incurred upon request. Customers remain responsible for costs that cannot be recovered from suppliers or logistics providers. Any recoverable portion of the amount paid will be refunded to the original payment method within 5–10 business days of cancellation approval.

sections.title: Carrier and Third-Party Commitments
sections.body: Cancellations that involve committed carrier bookings, freight reservations, or third-party logistics commitments already made on behalf of the customer may incur cancellation fees charged by those providers. These fees are passed through to the client at cost and are not subject to waiver.

sections.title: International Shipments
sections.body: For international orders, cancellation requests submitted after a shipment has been tendered to a carrier cannot be guaranteed. Arseen Enterprises LLC will make commercially reasonable efforts to intercept the shipment, but cannot guarantee retrieval once in transit.

sections.title: How to Request a Cancellation
sections.body: All cancellation requests must be submitted in writing to support@arseenenterprises.com. Include your name or business name, order or invoice number, and reason for cancellation. We will acknowledge your request within 1–2 business days and confirm the applicable fees, if any.

sections.title: Refunds on Cancelled Orders
sections.body: Eligible refunds for cancelled orders will be processed in accordance with our Refund Policy. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5–10 business days of cancellation approval.

sections.title: Arseen Enterprises LLC Right to Cancel
sections.body: Arseen Enterprises LLC reserves the right to cancel any service agreement if a client violates our Terms of Service, Acceptable Use Policy, or engages in fraudulent, illegal, or abusive conduct. In such cases, no refund will be issued for services already rendered. Where no services have been rendered, a full refund will be issued.

sections.title: Force Majeure
sections.body: Arseen Enterprises LLC is not liable for cancellations caused by circumstances beyond our reasonable control, including natural disasters, government actions, carrier strikes, or other force majeure events. We will notify affected clients promptly and work to reschedule or refund as appropriate.

sections.title: Payment Disputes
sections.body: Customers are encouraged to contact Arseen Enterprises LLC directly before initiating a payment dispute or chargeback so that the issue can be reviewed and, where possible, resolved promptly. Nothing in this policy limits any rights available to a customer under applicable law, card-network rules, or payment-provider dispute procedures. Arseen Enterprises LLC will respond to all payment disputes and chargebacks promptly and in good faith.

sections.title: Contact Us
sections.body: For cancellation requests or questions about this policy, contact us at support@arseenenterprises.com. Our response time is 1–2 business days. Arseen Enterprises LLC (US Office Address: 15 Tanguay Ave, Suite 112 #7C, Nashua, NH 03063, United States).
